note: Hand reads behind data/front-records/haarlemmerdijk-block.json. Heights are metres above the block-face strip's ground (strip.json groundNAP, the records' street datum). Each pand lists its reads strongest first: the builder keeps the first stated value per field and records any later read more than 0.5 m (or a different family/bays/storeys) away as a conflict. 'lane2-strip-read' = this lane's read of a 1 m gridded crop of the block-face strip (Gemeente Amsterdam panorama, CC BY 4.0; image staging/block-face/<face>/strip.jpg in the belt-haarlemmer-20261110 worktree, crop at 1.1-2x with brightness x1.6, 2026-11-13). 'reviewer-strip-read' = the belt-haarlemmer lane's 1 m grid reads of the same strips (2026-11-10), transcribed from the cited file. No Gemini or Jev reads are used.
